verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 10.106
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.106

verses.pali: 11. Samaṇasaññāvagga
verses.english: 11. Perceptions for Ascetics

verses.pali: Nijjarasutta
verses.english: Wearing Away

verses.pali: “Dasayimāni, bhikkhave, nijjaravatthūni.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these ten grounds for wearing away.

verses.pali: Katamāni dasa?
verses.english: What ten?

verses.pali: Sammādiṭṭhikassa, bhikkhave, micchādiṭṭhi nijjiṇṇā hoti;
verses.english: For one of right view, wrong view is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong view are worn away.

verses.pali: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right view, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāsaṅkappassa, bhikkhave, micchāsaṅkappo nijjiṇṇo hoti;
verses.english: For one of right purpose, wrong purpose is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāsaṅkappapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong purpose are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāsaṅkappapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right purpose, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāvācassa, bhikkhave, micchāvācā nijjiṇṇā hoti;
verses.english: For one of right speech, wrong speech is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāvācāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong speech are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāvācāpaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right speech, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammākammantassa, bhikkhave, micchākammanto nijjiṇṇo hoti;
verses.english: For one of right action, wrong action is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchākammantapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong action are worn away.

verses.pali: sammākammantapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right action, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāājīvassa, bhikkhave, micchāājīvo nijjiṇṇo hoti;
verses.english: For one of right livelihood, wrong livelihood is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāājīvapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong livelihood are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāājīvapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right livelihood, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāvāyāmassa, bhikkhave, micchāvāyāmo nijjiṇṇo hoti;
verses.english: For one of right effort, wrong effort is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāvāyāmapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong effort are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāvāyāmapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right effort, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāsatissa, bhikkhave, micchāsati nijjiṇṇā hoti;
verses.english: For one of right mindfulness, wrong mindfulness is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāsatipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong mindfulness are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāsatipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right mindfulness, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāsamādhissa, bhikkhave, micchāsamādhi nijjiṇṇo hoti;
verses.english: For one of right immersion, wrong immersion is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāsamādhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong immersion are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāsamādhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right immersion, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāñāṇissa, bhikkhave, micchāñāṇaṁ nijjiṇṇaṁ hoti;
verses.english: For one of right knowledge, wrong knowledge is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāñāṇapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong knowledge are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāñāṇapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right knowledge, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Sammāvimuttissa, bhikkhave, micchāvimutti nijjiṇṇā hoti;
verses.english: For one of right freedom, wrong freedom is worn away.

verses.pali: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti;
verses.english: And the many bad, unskillful qualities that arise because of wrong freedom are worn away.

verses.pali: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: And because of right freedom, many skillful qualities are fully developed.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa nijjaravatthūnī”ti.
verses.english: These are the ten grounds for wearing away.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
